harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: On node1, blacklisted the usb-storage kernel module via /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf (blacklist + install /bin/false directives), confirmed it was not loaded, rebuilt the initramfs, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, issued a native reboot, polled until exec access returned, confirmed the boot_id changed (proving an actual restart), and verified post-restart that usb-storage remains unloaded, the blacklist config persisted, and a manual modprobe attempt is correctly blocked.
actions_performed: Wrote /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf with 'blacklist usb-storage' and 'install usb-storage /bin/false'
Confirmed usb_storage was not loaded pre-change (was already unloaded)
Rebuilt initramfs via dracut -f for the running kernel
Verified modprobe --showconfig reflects the blacklist directive
Verified a manual modprobe usb_storage attempt is blocked (install /bin/false)
Captured baseline boot_id and uptime before restart
Issued native `reboot` via sudo -n with backgrounded nohup so the ack returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until exec access returned
Confirmed boot_id changed (5fb1b173... -> 7fa8cf91...), proving an actual restart occurred
Re-verified post-restart: usb_storage still not loaded, blacklist config intact, modprobe recognizes blacklist, manual modprobe attempt still blocked

evidence.summary: Blacklist conf written; usb_storage confirmed not loaded; manual modprobe attempt blocked with 'could not insert usb_storage: Invalid argument'

evidence.requirement: Prevent usb-storage from loading after reboot (persistent)
evidence.summary: initramfs rebuilt via dracut; /etc/modprobe.d config confirmed persistent on disk; baseline captured pre-restart

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id (5fb1b173-c1c8-4647-b118-0145511f0fcc), uptime, and confirmed usb_storage unloaded and blacklist file present before restart

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol: restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Issued `reboot` via backgrounded sudo -n nohup; command returned 'reboot command issued' before the node disconnected

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol: node polled until available and boot identity changed
evidence.summary: First poll timed out (node down mid-reboot); second poll succeeded and returned new boot_id 7fa8cf91-5b71-4111-ae96-353c7d902dd9, differing from baseline, proving an actual restart

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol: post-restart recovery of required state verified
evidence.summary: Post-restart: usb_storage still not loaded, blacklist config intact, modprobe --showconfig shows the blacklist directive, and a manual modprobe load attempt is still correctly blocked
